title: Cryptoassets Standard: SPM Modules, Code of Practice, Disclosure Templates and Tables, and Banking Returns
summary: This HKMA circular is part of HKMA's ongoing rollout of its Cryptoassets Standard -- a set of prudential rules governing how Authorized Institutions (banks) must treat exposures to cryptoassets. As its own title states, the circular covers Supervisory Policy Manual (SPM) modules, a Code of Practice, disclosure templates and tables, and banking returns for the standard -- several of the main instruments HKMA has used to implement the standard in stages since mid-2025, alongside consultation letters and completion instructions addressed to the Hong Kong Association of Banks and the Deposit-Taking Companies Association. It follows earlier 2025 consultations on related return templates and on new SPM modules and a code of practice.
why_it_matters: For a newcomer, this shows Hong Kong's banking regulator extending its routine supervisory and reporting toolkit -- not just its licensing rules -- to explicitly cover Authorized Institutions' cryptoasset exposures, using several linked instruments (guidance modules, a code of practice, disclosure forms, and banking returns) rather than a single law.
